**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.70. Level 2 will review it.

**What drove it:**
1. The 18930 BUY (7.94x depth, 1 tick from the touch) was cancelled in full after 803 ms. It had no fills, the trader had no opposite-side trade, and nothing rested on the other side. Feature (b) is absent.
2. 1.4 s after the cancel, a replacement BUY of 1893, exactly one tenth of the size, went in at the same price. That fits a corrected entry error.
3. There is no repetition (0 repeats in the session), no prior alerts, no news or risk event, and the trader is not a registered market maker. The other explanations are ruled out, and only fat finger is supported.

**What would change my mind:** a sell trade by this trader around the order, other oversized one-sided orders from the trader, or a record that 18930 was intended.
